integrity: Analytical proof in RESULT.md; independently reproducible exact rational finite checks in check_crosspoly.py. Mathematical originality is based on stated comparisons, not guaranteed globally.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for normalized uniform volume, real affine L2 projection and the cube/cross-polytope polar pair. It is not a theorem for arbitrary polar convex bodies, Hanner polytopes, surface sampling or higher-degree spaces; literature priority remains subject to incomplete indexing.
title: Sharp affine projection on cross-polytopes and the strict cube-duality gap
